---
title: Edit Customer Details
description: >-
  Editing view, and update a customer information such as name, email, and
  contact details.
---
## Step

1. Navigate to Customers, click on a specific customer to view full details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="581" height="267" />

2. Click Edit Customer to edit customer information.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="528" height="205" />

3. Update customer details and save changes.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="497" height="404" />
